author: SciShow
description:
Since 2022, the use of large language model chatbots like ChatGPT has skyrocketed. This explosion in usage comes with some real and serious concerns, like people who experience AI psychosis. It can be deadly, so we're going to talk about it. What it is, how dangerous it can be, and what we can do about it.

Hosted by: Reid Reimers (he/him)
